alignments.note: Title 'A Psalm' answers to no morpheme; one supplied run (rule 2).

'fight against' object relation on the marker (rule 16).

'stop' writes the closing; margin's 'battle axe' set aside (rule 38).

Volitive frame; 'upon' is the supplied preposition reaching the object suffix (rule 44).
